proves.claim: With runners.oneServePerHost on, runService passes serveRunner a peer naming its session and the GUI probe, and with it off passes none.

cli.io-runner-service.peer-port-on.why: Without it, a regression where with runners.oneServePerHost on, runService passes serveRunner a peer naming its session and the GUI probe, and with it off passes none would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: guiRunning is true only when launchctl reports the GUI-session service running, and false on a nonzero exit or a thrown error.

cli.io-runner-service.gui-running-probe.why: Without it, a regression where guiRunning is true only when launchctl reports the GUI-session service running, and false on a nonzero exit or a thrown error would pass unnoticed.
